title: kblog.py propose counts the ops rows whose item no commit or item file names and leaves them out unless asked
goal: kblog.py propose reports how many ops aggregates name an item id that no backlog item file and no KB-Work trailer of the repository names (unknown=N) and proposes none of them unless --unknown is given, so fixture rows are not proposed as fleet history again; a planted sidecar with a known and an unknown item proposes one row and counts one unknown. Retrospective of SP-smqwmchu: ST-vaby3y5b proposed 6412 rows of test fixtures and its commit called them the retired fleet's runs, unchecked.
